about.v100highlights:
• Tasks, bills, finance, notes, and family requests
• Grocery lists, prayer times with reminders, health tracking
• Entertainment watchlist with offline highlights
• Fully offline in English and Bangla
about.termsBody:
1. Gochao is for personal organization. Your data stays on this device; there are no accounts, no cloud sync, and no analytics.

2. Records are yours alone. A bill marked paid, a logged prayer, or a taken dose is your own record — never proof for anyone else, and never medical, financial, or religious advice.

3. The app is provided as-is, without warranty. Deleting the app deletes all its data.

4. Continued use after an update means you accept the terms shipped with that version.
about.privacyBody:
Gochao works fully offline.

Everything you enter — tasks, finances, family, health, prayers, lists — is stored in a database on this device only. The app makes no network requests except when you tap a link (for example, a saved video or Contact Developer).

Permissions are used only for what you ask: device location calculates prayer times when you tap “Use my location”; notifications deliver prayer reminders you enable. Denying either only disables that feature.

There is no app lock or database encryption yet — your device lock screen is the protection. Deleting the app permanently deletes all data.
